response.overview: In the future world, due to the company's full digitalisation, J is told to resign by the robot HR, packs up his things and returns home, but he has not been able to contact his girlfriend S. After losing his job, J is unable to afford the daily smart network fees, and is told by the smart company to cancel all of his network accounts if he doesn't renew the fees within a week.J is in a hurry to find a job and his girlfriend S, and after a week of fruitless efforts, he has no choice but to sell his smart Id to the black market, and the trafficking of IDs requires the Remove the brain chip, the day before the operation, J contacted his girlfriend S's company, only to remember that S is just a smart android......
response.title: J Cyberpunk
